topic: Singapore: merger with Malaysia and separation in 1963-1965
scope_decisions: The artifact set covers one topic only and stays within 1963-1965, using brief background only when needed to explain the merger path.

decisions: Scope is limited to Singapore's entry into Malaysia in 1963 and separation in 1965.
The merger is framed as a constitutional and economic project, not as a completed national settlement.
The separation moment is anchored to the legal sequence in August 1965 and the 9 August proclamation.
Multilingual terms are used only as controlled benchmark markers, not as decorative text.
